note: Darshan inbox (scripts/inbox.mjs, .github/workflows/inbox.yml): the owner mails his OWN darshan photos / videos with a subject that starts with the word 'Shyam' (any case); daily.yml's evening run picks them up, edits them and puts them into the owner-footage lane (automation/owner-footage.json) and the real-stills banks (footage/). Allowed senders are NOT listed here (public repo): they are the repo secret INBOX_ALLOWED_SENDERS (comma-separated) plus the inbox account itself. Mail from anyone else is labelled 'shyam-ignored' and never answered.
